post.description: Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC. OAuth resource must match canonical URL. Initialize then tools/list or tools/call; no REST envelope. Missing/invalid token receives OAuth WWW-Authenticate challenge. Conversational tools createWritingSession/sendWriterMessage/getWriterConversation/listDrafts use the same endpoint; see x-mcp-tools for contracts. The full catalogue has 25 tools before scope filtering. publishDraft accepts optional publicationId only to select an authorized destination for an origin-owned unassigned session; assigned rehoming is forbidden.

post.description: Approve policy or deny. Origin must equal issuer. Deny requires only decision and formProof. Proof is account/request-bound. Approval validates current publication ownership. No raw tokens returned. Approval AND denial also require the provider transaction binding cookie from GET /oauth/authorize. Use the same browser/Postman cookie jar; Clerk JWT, proof and Origin alone are insufficient.

x-mcp-tools.name: createWritingSession
x-mcp-tools.description: Primary collaborative writer flow. publicationId optional; unassigned sessions accessible only to originating MCP connection and owner UI. Prebuilt styles only while unassigned. Assigned session uses current publication grant/style. No hosted conversation proof claimed by this schema.

x-mcp-tools.name: sendWriterMessage
x-mcp-tools.description: Durably queue a message through the same UI writer engine/history. Reuse same session/key/message for submission recovery. Conflict on different message under same key; interrupted turns never automatically replay. Delegated writer tools omit raw publishing.

x-mcp-tools.name: getWriterConversation
x-mcp-tools.description: Bounded safe user/assistant text; turnId filters receipts independently from message pagination. Completed turn may be discussion without saved draft.

x-mcp-tools.name: listDrafts
x-mcp-tools.description: Versioned drafts saved by Hot Metal writer; retrieve full content with getDraftVersion.
